extraction.name: Prompted Textures Dataset (PTD)
extraction.description: A synthetic texture dataset of 246,285 images across 56 texture classes, created using text-to-image generation with Stable Diffusion and a multi-stage refinement process.
extraction.creator: Blaine Hoak and Patrick McDaniel
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by constructing texture-specific text prompts, generating images with Stable Diffusion, and then filtering the generated images through a three-stage refinement process consisting of frequency analysis, patch variance filtering, and CLIP score filtering. Images flagged by the Stable Diffusion NSFW safety filter were regenerated, and flagged images were excluded from the final released dataset.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Up to 60% of the initial generated images were flagged as NSFW by the Stable Diffusion safety filter; these flagged images were excluded from the final dataset and not released.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Text prompts constructed from texture classes and descriptors; generated texture images produced by Stable Diffusion; comparison reference data from the Describable Textures Dataset (DTD).
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Generated images were refined by retaining the top 80% by frequency cutoff within each texture class, removing the bottom 20% by patch variance within each class, and removing the bottom 20% by CLIP score within each class. Flagged NSFW images were regenerated during generation and excluded from the final dataset.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were filtered to remove object-like images, homogeneous images, and images poorly aligned with prompts using frequency filtering, patch variance filtering, and CLIP-based filtering. The final dataset was balanced across texture classes.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human evaluation was conducted by asking participants to rate image quality and how well each image represented the provided descriptor on a 1 to 5 scale.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Nine participants evaluated 900 unique images. Mean quality and representativeness scores were computed across refinement stages, showing improvements after each stage.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Stable Diffusion; CLIP scoring; Fourier transform / frequency analysis; patch variance filtering
